headline: Digital growth continues; MGM swing swamps GAAP earnings
summary_short: Total revenue was $436.7M (-1% y/y) with Digital revenue up 6% to $289.9M offsetting a 16% Print decline; net earnings of $506.9M and diluted EPS of $6.68 (+160% y/y) were driven almost entirely by a $721.7M unrealized mark-to-market gain on the company's MGM Resorts stake, not operating performance.
summary_long: Digital's 11th straight quarter of growth (+6% to $289.9M) came from 16% growth in non-session-based revenue (licensing +23%, D/Cipher+ ramp), while Print fell 16% on the print-to-digital migration. Operating loss widened to $14.3M as Corporate costs rose on $18.4M of stock-based compensation tied to the People Inc./Corporate consolidation. Adjusted EBITDA rose 15% to $55.9M. Net earnings and EPS were dominated by a $721.7M unrealized gain on the company's MGM Resorts shares; excluding that, results were roughly flat. Cash stood at $1.1B, long-term debt $1.4B. The board approved a new 10M-share buyback, and the company agreed to sell its LP stake in a third-party fund for ~$189M, closing Q3.

drivers.explanation: 6% Digital revenue growth (licensing +23%, performance marketing +13%) was more than offset by a 16% Print decline from the ongoing print-to-digital migration and portfolio optimization.

Corporate operating loss widened $17.6M mainly on $18.4M higher stock-based compensation from accelerating employee awards tied to the People Inc./Corporate consolidation, plus $3.7M of Google antitrust litigation costs at Digital.
Driven almost entirely by a $721.7M unrealized mark-to-market gain on the company's MGM Resorts International shares, versus a $307.4M unrealized gain in the prior-year quarter.

Follows pretax income: the MGM unrealized gain swing dwarfs the modest decline in underlying operating results; company states this makes net earnings 'very volatile' and not representative of operating performance.
Tracks net income's MGM-driven swing; also aided by a lower diluted share count (75.9M vs 82.2M) from ongoing buybacks.
Reflects continued share repurchases; company bought back $133.3M of treasury stock in H1 2026 and the board approved a new 10M-share authorization in June 2026.
Modest scheduled term-loan principal payments at the People Inc. subsidiary, the sole obligor of the debt.

FY2026 outlook: total Adjusted EBITDA of $255-290M and total operating income of $15-80M, with People Inc. Adjusted EBITDA of $325-355M; Digital revenue and Adjusted EBITDA both expected to grow mid-to-high single digits for the year.
